user.title: RegisteredUser
user.description: Information about a registered system user, including admin states and auth credentials.

id.description: Unique user identity code, lowercased username.

name.description: Full name or display label of the user.

passwordHash.description: Private security password code for logins.

isAdmin.description: Indicates if the user has database inspection capabilities.

isSuper.description: Indicates if the user is Hamza Saif with full statements audit rights.

user_state.title: AppState
user_state.description: The isolated financial state data for a client, containing ledger indices, transactions log, budgets, goals, and visual preferences.

userAvatar.description: Profile emoji or image data string.

/users/{username}.description: Direct user profile documents tracked by unique lowercased usernames to prevent registry collisions.

/user_states/{username}.description: Deep isolated ledger records containing recent activities, cash pools, budgets and statements config connected directly to lowercased usernames.
